basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated separately through e-mail to shortlisted candidates

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Candidates applying for the post must be below 50 years of age as of 28 October 2026.

qualification.details: The cut-off date for determining age, experience, and educational qualification is 28 October 2026.

salary_details.details: The remuneration will be commensurate with the candidate's domain knowledge, skills, and experience. Further, the remuneration shall not be more than twenty percent higher than the remunerations received in any of the previous services/engagements. The remuneration may be reviewed after completion of one year on an annual basis, with an annual remuneration increment ranging between 03% to 10% subject to performance assessment by the Reporting and Reviewing Officer.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications received within the due date by a Committee
followed by a shortlisting-based interview for shortlisted candidates only.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of IIT Delhi at www.iitd.ac.in and access the link Jobs@IITDelhi under the heading Non-Academic to download the prescribed Application Form.

Fill out the prescribed application form completely with detailed information regarding educational qualifications (indicating percentage of marks/division obtained in each examination) and details of work experience.
Affix a recent passport size photograph duly filled by you on the application form.

Gather self-attested copies of documents supporting educational qualifications and experience, and convert them into PDF format (all scanned documents must be clearly legible, preferably at a resolution of 300 dpi or higher).
Mail the filled-in application form along with the supporting PDF documents to [email protected] on or before 28 October 2026. Do not submit a hard copy through Post or Courier.
important_instructions: This engagement is purely on a contract basis initially for a period of 01 year, which can be extended up to a maximum of 03 years subject to requirement and review of satisfactory work performance. Appearance in the interview and selection thereafter does not entitle any claim whatsoever for permanency on the regular establishment of IIT Delhi. Incomplete application forms will be summarily rejected. Only shortlisted candidates will be considered for the interview and notified via email. If the engagement is at the upper limit of the remuneration range, no annual remuneration increment shall be admissible. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, postpone or cancel the recruitment altogether without assigning any reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by IIT Delhi to engage 01 Consultant (Student Counsellor) for counselling services on a contract basis through a shortlisting-based interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Consultant (Student Counsellor).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form via email is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A. (Hons.) in Psychology, M.A. (Hons.) in Psychology with at least 01 year of clinical/mental healthcare experience in a hospital, institute, clinic, or counselling services of an educational institution (college experience).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 50 years of age as of 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor)?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration ranges from Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- per month, depending on the candidate's domain knowledge, skills, and experience.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IIT Delhi Consultant (Student Counsellor) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the IIT Delhi website, fill it out, attach self-attested educational and experience documents in PDF format, and email it to [email protected] by 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent position at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: No, this is purely a temporary engagement on a contract basis for 01 year, extendable up to a maximum of 03 years, and does not entitle any claim for permanency on the regular establishment.
